PostgreSQL provider for PowerTraces — exports traces/logs straight to PostgreSQL via connection string, no EF Core, tables created automatically.

Base package for exporting OpenTelemetry traces/logs straight to a database via connection string — no collector, no EF Core. Database-agnostic on its own; add PowerTraces.MSSQL, .PostgreSQL, .MongoDb, or .MySQL for a concrete database, or implement IStorageWriter yourself for any other one.
Traces/logs viewer UI + query API for the PowerTraces exporter. Mount with app.MapPowerTracesDashboard(connectionString) — no DI registration needed, the UI is embedded in the package.
MySQL/MariaDB provider for PowerTraces — exports traces/logs straight to MySQL via connection string, no EF Core, tables created automatically.

Local-filesystem provider for PowerTraces — exports traces/logs straight to JSON files on disk (a folder per day, one file per trace), with automatic retention cleanup. No database at all; meant for local development, small deployments, or as a fallback when a real database isn't available.
MongoDB provider for PowerTraces — exports traces/logs straight to MongoDB via connection string, no EF Core, collections/indexes created automatically.
SQL Server provider for PowerTraces — exports traces/logs straight to SQL Server via connection string, no EF Core, tables created automatically.
